# Demography
```{r}
p <- list.map(
  unique(clinic2$groupe),
  f(x) ~ {
    res <- filter(clinic2, groupe == x) %>%
    filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(sexe)) %>%
    age_pyramid("age", "sexe", seq(0, 100, 10), colour = brewer.pal(4, "Paired")[3:4]) + 
    ggtitle(x) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
  plot(res)
  }
)

  select(age, groupe, patient) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = groupe, values_from = age) %>%
  column_to_rownames("patient") %>%
  plot_violin(
    colour = palette_discrete()[seq(3)],
    cex = 1.2,
    pch_size = 3,
    pch_alpha = 0.25,
    coef = 1.5,
    breaks = c(25, 50, 75),
    label = TRUE,
    title = "Age"
  )

p <- clinic2 %>%
    group_by(groupe) %>%
    summarise(print_numeric(age)) %>% 
    select(-c("Variables", "Kurtosis", "Skewness", "Normality"))
p
kable0(p) %>%
  save_kable(file = file.path(path_fig, "stats_age.png"), zoom = 2)
    

filter(clinic2, is.na(age)) %>% 
  select(patient)
```

```{r}
list.map(
  find_dates(clinic2),
  f(x, y) ~{
    if (y != 2){
      regex <- "%Y-%m"
    } else {
      regex <- "%Y"
    }
    pull(clinic2, x) %>%
      plot_date(
        func2 = ymd, 
        title = str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>% str_to_sentence(),
        regex = regex
      )
  }
)
```

```{r}
list.map(
  unique(clinic2$groupe),
  f(i) ~ {
    res <- filter(clinic2, groupe == i)
  list.map(
    find_dates(res),
    f(x, y) ~{
      if (y != 2){
        regex <- "%Y-%m"
      } else {
        regex <- "%Y"
      }
      pull(res, x) %>%
        plot_date(
          func2 = ymd, 
          title = paste(i, ":", str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>% str_to_sentence()),
          regex = regex
        )
    }
  )
  }
)
```
```{r}
p <- list.map(
  find_dates(clinic2)[-5],
  f(x, y) ~ {
clinic2 %>%
    mutate(
    years = pull(., x) %>% 
        year() %>% as.character()
)  %>%
    select(years, groupe) %>%
    plot_bar_2cat(
        sort = c("HD", "DA", "PN"),
        stats = FALSE,
        title = str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>% str_to_sentence()
    ) -> res
    plot(res)
  }
)
```

```{r}
p <- list.map(
  find_dates(clinic2)[-5],
  f(x, y) ~ {
    print(x)
    if(y %in% c(3, 4)) {
      res <- filter(clinic2, groupe != "HD")
    } else {
      res <- clinic2
    }
    if (y == 1) {
      res <- res %>%
      mutate(
        days = pull(., all_of(x)) %>% 
        difftime(Sys.Date(), .) %>% 
        as.numeric()
        ) 
    } else {
      res <- res %>%
      mutate(
        days = pull(., all_of(x)) %>% 
        difftime(pull(res, "date_inclusion"), ., units = "days") %>% 
        as.numeric()
        ) 
    }
    select(res, days, groupe, patient) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = groupe, values_from = days) %>%
    column_to_rownames("patient") %>%
    plot_violin(
      colour = palette_discrete()[seq(length(unique(pull(res, "groupe"))))],
      cex = 1.2,
      pch_size = 3,
      pch_alpha = 0.25,
      coef = 1.5,
      label = TRUE,
      width_text = 20,
      title = str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>% str_to_sentence(),
      func_label = label_date,
      ratio_labs = 1
    ) -> res
    plot(res)
  }
)
```

```{r}
clinic2 <- clinic2 %>%
  mutate(
    ethnie = factor(ethnie, levels = c(0, 1, 2), labels = c("Caucasian", "Asian", "African")),
    da_pn = factor(da_pn, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
         )
  
list.map(
    c("ethnie", "da_pn"),
    f(x) ~ {
      mutate(clinic2, Group = !!sym(x)) %>%
      select(Group, groupe) %>%
      plot_bar_2cat(
        sort = c("HD", "DA", "PN"),
        stats = FALSE,
        title = str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>% str_to_sentence()
    )
    }
  )
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
categorical_variables <- select(clinic2, -all_of(c(date_variables, numeric_variables)))

df <-  df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(numeric_variables), ~ as.numeric(.)))
```
